name: @red-cup-engineering/route-directed-yield-service
description: Tidepool's directed-yield routing: reads a member's Morpho vault position through treasury-observation-service, computes the accrued shares to redeem (never principal), and emits one routing intent -- paper unless a mandate is supplied and admitted by key-management's sign-with-wallet. The Moonwell WELL claim is the first-cycle special case. lib/contracts/route-directed-yield.sol is the stateless on-chain helper that redeems and forwards in one call.

scripts.check: for f in src/*.mjs scripts/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
